metadata.description: Confident AI agent skills for onboarding, AI tracing, eval setup, and the Confident AI API. For Cursor.

plugins.name: confident-onboard
plugins.description: Onboard to Confident AI from your coding agent: sign in through the browser, save the API key without exposing it, add tracing, run your app on a batch of inputs, and confirm the traces arrived.

plugins.name: confident-trace
plugins.description: Skills for instrumenting AI applications with the confident-trace SDK, exporting raw OpenTelemetry traces to Confident AI, and migrating from Langfuse.

plugins.name: confident-client
plugins.description: Skills for managing Confident AI organizations, projects, members, roles, governance policies, and API keys with the confident-ai SDK.

plugins.name: confident-eval-setup
plugins.description: Skills for getting an LLM app ready to evaluate on Confident AI: create and verify an AI connection over the Confident AI MCP server and upload a dataset.
